Author: The Enceladeum
Name: HOutfits
Punchline: Apply full sets, loose pieces and facewear to your character in Glamourer with a single click.
Description: Browse the game's named sets, sets recovered by item name, every other wearable piece and facewear, with large icon previews on hover, and apply a whole set or any single piece to your character through Glamourer, instead of picking each item from a dropdown.
Changelog: 0.4.1: tidier layout. The search box now sits in the same place on every tab, with each tab's own options beneath it, and the status message no longer pushes the tabs down when it first appears. The installer description now mentions loose gear and facewear.
